Gradient Color Pallete

A downloadable texture

Download NowName your own price

I have recently decided to potentially start making cutesy style assets for my future asset packs, and have noticed that there's no big gradient texture atlases that I can find with enough variety.

I have sampled colors from an assortment of games such as Animal Crossing, Subnautica and even DOOM Eternal.

I will be using this exact same gradient texture for my free cutesy asset packs.
